# Adjacency Matrix of an Undirected Graph

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Adjacency Matrix of an Undirected Graph

This is the adjacency matrix we created before:

![Adjacency Matrix](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's consider the following element:

![Connection Between A and A in Adjacency Matrix](data:image/png;base64,)

In the above diagram, the highlighted portion represents the connection between A and A. Since there's no path connecting A to A, its value is set to 0.

Similarly, consider this element in the matrix.

![Connection Between B and C in Adjacency Matrix](data:image/png;base64,)

This represents the connection between vertex B and vertex C. Since there's an edge connecting these two vertices, its value is set to 1.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
